# Accepted cross-area duplication for the weekly duplication sweep
# (.github/workflows/nightly-health.yml, job duplication-sweep). Added for #2866.
#
# The sweep alerts on a cross-area duplicate pair when either file changed on master in the last
# 7 days. A pair listed here is skipped, in either order, so a pair that was reviewed does not
# re-alert every time one of its files is edited. New pairs still alert.
#
# One pair per line, four fields separated by " | ":
#   <repo path A> | <repo path B> | <record> | <reason>
# - <record> is the issue that tracks removing the duplication (#1234) or the ADR that makes it
#   deliberate (ADR-024). No record, no entry: this list is not a place to park a duplicate.
# - The reason must not contain " | " (it would read as a fifth field and be reported malformed).
# - An entry covers every cluster between its two files, not one cluster: keep the reason true
#   for the whole pair.
# - Delete the line when the duplication is gone. The sweep log lists entries that no longer match
#   any pair, and malformed lines make the sweep report failing instead of being ignored.

# --- Deliberate (no fix planned) ---
# (none at present; the write-handler pair from #2866 dropped below the floor)
